title: Homology API for the relative exchange
statement: For any commutative square and coefficient map, the degree-q relative exchange equals the exact inverse-image homology comparison followed by H^q of the derived relative coefficient mate. Conventions and constructions: [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-kun-commutative-derived-exchange], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-kun-relative-higher-image-derived-map], [def-kun-relative-higher-image-exchange], [def-kun-relative-higher-image-homology-iso].

proof.text: Unfold the two concrete mate composites. Their terms agree definitionally; no exchange invertibility is used.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeHigherDirectImageExchange_eq_homology
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (F' : Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').obj F ⟶ F') (q : ℕ) :
    relativeHigherDirectImageExchange sq F F' φ q =
      (relativeHigherDirectImageHomologyIso f g F q).hom ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)).map
        (relativeHigherDirectImageDerivedMap sq F F' φ)
